name: Teens 5-Day Summer Series: The Pastry Showcase
description: Cooking Class Description: Designed for ages 12 and older; this series combines creativity with essential culinary skills as teens dive into the world of advanced baking and pastry. Limited to just four guests; you'll enjoy personalized instruction from our in-house coffee specialist as you learn how to brew café-quality coffee using French Press and Pour Over methods.This in-store experience covers everything from selecting the right equipment and grind size to perfecting brew ratios and techniques. Whether you’re new to brewing or looking to elevate your morning ritual; you’ll leave with the skills and confidence to craft a balanced; flavorful cup—one you'll be proud to make at home.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

Limited to just four guests; you'll enjoy personalized instruction from our in-house coffee specialist as you learn how to brew café-quality coffee using French Press and Pour Over methods.This in-store experience covers everything from selecting the right equipment and grind size to perfecting brew ratios and techniques. Whether you’re new to brewing or looking to elevate your morning ritual; you’ll leave with the skills and confidence to craft a balanced; flavorful cup—one you'll be proud to make at home.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

Limited to just four guests; you'll enjoy personalized instruction from our in-house coffee specialist as you learn how to brew café-quality coffee using French Press and Pour Over methods.This in-store experience covers everything from selecting the right equipment and grind size to perfecting brew ratios and techniques. Whether you’re new to brewing or looking to elevate your morning ritual; you’ll leave with the skills and confidence to craft a balanced; flavorful cup—one you'll be proud to make at home.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

Our chef instructor will walk you through creating a refreshing salad with a vibrant mix of chopped cucumber; tomatoes and fresh mint. Learn the tips and tricks to master Tahdig—a beloved golden crispy rice dish infused with fragrant saffron; prepared in a Scanpan for perfect results. Elevate your grilling skills as you make chicken kabobs that are tender and packed with flavor before finishing with sweet; delicate cream puffs filled with luscious pistachio cream.What To Expect: In our classes you'll work together with other students (in groups of 4); sharing workstations and equipment in a fun; hands-on environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 2 hours; unless otherwise noted above.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-20 students; depending on location.You will be standing; cooking; and working for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back.Students receive a coupon for 10% off in-store purchases the day of class.Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class.Prices vary by location.Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.

Your chef instructor will walk you through Smoked Chocolate Truffles tempered on the Control Freak induction and finished with a kiss of smoke from the Smoking Gun; followed by a silky Honey Ice Cream churned in the Smart Scoop. You'll work flaky dough and rich frangipane in the Paradice food processor for a Peach Cherry Frangipane Galette; then pull fresh shots on the Oracle to flavor Espresso Chewy Caramels and a Cold Brew Pot de Creme finished with whipped cream and chocolate espresso beans.What To Expect: In our classes you'll work together with other students (in groups of 4); sharing workstations and equipment in a fun; hands-on environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 2 hours; unless otherwise noted above.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-20 students; depending on location.You will be standing; cooking; and working for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back.Students receive a coupon for 10% off in-store purchases the day of class.Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class.Prices vary by location.Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.

Limited to just four guests; you'll enjoy personalized instruction from our in-house coffee specialist as you learn how to brew café-quality coffee using French Press and Pour Over methods.This in-store experience covers everything from selecting the right equipment and grind size to perfecting brew ratios and techniques. Whether you’re new to brewing or looking to elevate your morning ritual; you’ll leave with the skills and confidence to craft a balanced; flavorful cup—one you'll be proud to make at home.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

Limited to just four guests; you'll enjoy personalized instruction from our in-house coffee specialist as you learn how to brew café-quality coffee using French Press and Pour Over methods.This in-store experience covers everything from selecting the right equipment and grind size to perfecting brew ratios and techniques. Whether you’re new to brewing or looking to elevate your morning ritual; you’ll leave with the skills and confidence to craft a balanced; flavorful cup—one you'll be proud to make at home.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

You'll braise chicken thighs until fall-apart tender and finish them with briny capers and a glossy pan sauce; then dress a sturdy kale salad with sharp Parmesan vinaigrette. White balsamic roasted cauliflower with thyme brings sweetness and depth; and the meal closes with Caffé Budino; a silky coffee-infused pudding.What To Expect: In our classes you'll work together with other students (in groups of 4); sharing workstations and equipment in a fun; hands-on environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 2 hours; unless otherwise noted above.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-20 students; depending on location.You will be standing; cooking; and working for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back.Students receive a coupon for 10% off in-store purchases the day of class.Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class.Prices vary by location.Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.

You'll make the whole spread from scratch: beautifully seasoned roast beef with tangy horseradish cream; herbed roasted potatoes with crispy edges and sautéed Brussels sprouts done right. And because no proper roast is complete without something sweet; you'll finish with Sticky Toffee Pudding; warm and dense and drenched in toffee sauce.What To Expect: In our classes you'll work together with other students (in groups of 4); sharing workstations and equipment in a fun; hands-on environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 2 hours; unless otherwise noted above.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-20 students; depending on location.You will be standing; cooking; and working for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back.Students receive a coupon for 10% off in-store purchases the day of class.Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class.Prices vary by location.Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.
